t: Rate spice and gentle reads yourself
b: Open any series and tap 🌶️ Rate spice & gentle read. Your rating drives your own filters and challenges, earns XP, and helps us rate books for everyone.

t: Levels, classes and your character card
b: Earn XP for everything you do in the app: adding and reading books, stars, reviews, streaks, finishing series, friends, fixes, and buying books we recommend. Level up to unlock avatar frames, get a class from your stats (or pick your own), and share a character card that gets shinier as you level, from Common to Mythic. Tap the bars at the top of your Shelf to see it all.
Missing or wrong cover? Open the series, tap Add a cover or ISBN, and type the ISBN from the back of the book. We find the cover for you, and books we don't carry yet get sent to the shop to list.

t: Mark omnibus and deluxe books as read
b: On a series page, tap Read, then tap the omnibus or deluxe book. When we know which volumes it holds, those get marked read too.
Bring in what you've read from Goodreads, StoryGraph or a Bookmory backup, with finish dates, stars and reviews. Find it on the Reading page.

t: Everything you've read, in one list
b: The Reading page now has a fold-out list of every volume you've read, with your ratings and reviews.
Keep a private list of books you stopped reading, with notes on why. It's on the Reading page.
Tap a day on the calendar, then tap a book to rate and review that volume.

t: Hundreds of new series in the shop
b: We added listings for series on your shelves we'd never carried, so more of your books get covers and details. Tap 🔎 Find it for me on any we don't have in stock.

t: Finds: missing volumes and picks for you
b: The Finds tab now shows volumes you're missing and series recommended for you, including ones we'll hunt down for you.
Answer a few quick questions and get in-stock picks, skipping series you already own.
Turn on alerts for restocks, shop messages and deals, and see a count on the app icon.
Omnibus, 3-in-1, deluxe and collector's editions now sit inside their main series and count the volumes they hold.
Send us notes, fixes or requests from the app and see our replies in Messages.

t: Your calendar: sales, events and deliveries
b: See shop sales, conventions we'll be at, orders on the way and mystery-box reveal days.
Add your collection from a Goodreads, Libib or spreadsheet export, matched by ISBN.
Follow friends, see what they're reading, compare Bingo cards and the monthly leaderboard, and pick an avatar.
Track books you've lent out or have on hold, and see your website wishlist in the app.
